verses.english: “Mendicants, these two misrepresent the Realized One.

verses.pali: Yo ca neyyatthaṁ suttantaṁ nītattho suttantoti dīpeti, yo ca nītatthaṁ suttantaṁ neyyattho suttantoti dīpeti.
verses.english: One who explains a discourse in need of interpretation as a discourse whose meaning is explicit. And one who explains a discourse whose meaning is explicit as a discourse in need of interpretation.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve tathāgataṁ abbhācikkhantī”ti.
verses.english: These two misrepresent the Realized One.”
